headline.caveat: Dollar terms undisclosed. Master agreement to purchase power from a fleet of Kairos SMRs totaling 500MW by 2035; first deployment targeted ~2030.

realized_to_date.caveat: No reactors online; development-milestone payments, if any, are not disclosed.

nature_md: Master plant development agreement (Oct 2024) under which Google will buy power from a fleet of Kairos Power fluoride-salt-cooled SMRs — up to ~7 reactors totaling 500MW deployed by 2035, with the first unit targeted around 2030. Orders are placed against development milestones rather than a single signed EPC contract, giving Kairos demand certainty to reach NRC licensing and FOAK construction (building on its Hermes demonstration reactors in Oak Ridge, TN). Highly conditional: capacity, timing, and price all depend on licensing and build success.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Google records no liability today; power purchases would be opex from each unit's COD (2030+). Any development-stage payments are undisclosed and immaterial to Alphabet.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Kairos is pre-revenue on power; the offtake underpins project financing and DOE cost-share. Revenue recognition begins only at COD of each reactor — a decade-long lag between announcement and cash.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** the first corporate order book for SMRs — exactly the demand signal advanced nuclear needed. **Bear:** zero MW exist; every milestone (licensing, FOAK cost, supply chain) sits ahead, and the announced 500MW-by-2035 is a target, not a contract with liquidated damages.
